capabilities: Page through PDFs one screen at a time
Split tall pages into screen-sized stops on mobile landscape
Restore and merge reading position and bookmarks across devices
Record reading sessions and settle daily totals into a book note
Read EPUBs with adjustable margins, fonts, and columns
disambiguation: Not a pager or notification tool; it is a PDF and EPUB reader that pages one screen at a time.
extras: Installed through BRAT as a beta plugin; relies on Obsidian's internal PDF.js viewer, so an Obsidian update may require a compatibility update. Reading records are stored as JSON in a configurable vault folder so a sync tool can carry them between devices.
intentEvidence: It works in Obsidian's existing PDF tab rather than importing or rewriting the PDF.
problem: Obsidian's PDF viewer scrolls continuously and does not keep or sync reading position, bookmarks, or reading time, which makes reading on a phone awkward.

relations.evidence: Uses Obsidian's internal PDF.js viewer interface.
The built-in EPUB reader uses EPUB.js for single-screen pagination

summary: PDF and EPUB reader that shows one screen at a time, with resume position, bookmarks, and synced reading-time logs.
